placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Stoke Park offers a mix of open slopes, woodland and historic landscape features. Use the council's walking maps to select a route that works for your family rather than trying to explore the whole estate at once.

Our family idea: choose a short trail and look for the wooden sculptures or a view of the yellow Dower House. The house is private housing, so enjoy it as part of the scenery.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families interested in local landscapes and varied walking routes.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Walking trails, an accessible-path option and outdoor exercise equipment.
placepracticalinfo.parking: There is no dedicated car park; plan your arrival using the council visitor information.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Some areas are grazed by cattle or goats. Follow notices, keep your distance from livestock and supervise children around ponds.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Stoke Park Estate, Duchess Gate, Park Road, Stapleton, Bristol, BS16 1AU
placevisitmap.travelNote: There is no dedicated car park; plan your arrival using the council visitor information. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
